process.rule: This receipt narrows proof vocabulary only; it does not replace, reinterpret, or extend the preserved process decisions.

scope.decision: Freeze the smallest closed, applicability-first vocabulary for evidence-bound TaskFingerprint retrieval and candidate SolutionPattern evaluation.
included: paired holdout metrics for P17 and P18

receiptDecision.basis: The vocabulary is complete, but no digest-bound #288 evidence input is present at the baseline commit. A vocabulary decision is not empirical proof.

closedVocabulary.closedWorldRule: Only constants listed in this object are valid. Unknown values, omitted required values, type errors, and prose substitutions fail closed.

canonicalEncoding.identifierRule: Identifiers are case-sensitive and are not trimmed, repaired, inferred, or synonym-expanded.
canonicalEncoding.setRule: Fields declared as sets are encoded as duplicate-free arrays sorted by Unicode code point.
canonicalEncoding.proseRule: Descriptions and rationales are non-authoritative. They cannot supply or repair a missing, malformed, unknown, or incompatible typed value.

predicateClause.factPathFormat: RFC6901 JSON Pointer into the canonical TaskFingerprint or a resolved dependency record

evaluation.combination: All clauses are conjunctive. Any FALSE denies; otherwise any UNKNOWN denies; only all TRUE can be applicable.
evaluation.disjunctionRule: Represent alternatives as separate, independently evidenced SolutionPattern candidates; free-form OR expressions are invalid.

TaskFingerprint.purpose: A canonical structural identity used to decide applicability before any experience is retrieved.

fieldRules.taskFamilyId: Exactly one deterministically admitted TaskFamily identifier.
fieldRules.objectiveShapeId: Identifier for the required outcome shape, not topical wording.
fieldRules.inputShapeId: Identifier for the typed input structure.
fieldRules.outputShapeId: Identifier for the typed acceptance/output structure.
fieldRules.contextShapeId: Identifier for the structural operating context; cosmetic wording is excluded.
fieldRules.constraintIds: Sorted set of typed safety, authority, and task invariants.
fieldRules.dependencyIds: Sorted set of dependency identifiers required by the task.
fieldRules.versionVector: Sorted array of componentId, versionScheme, and exact value records.
fieldRules.canonicalDigest: Digest of the canonical ordered structural dimensions only.

TaskFingerprint.identityRule: Topical or embedding similarity is not a structural dimension and cannot change family membership or applicability.
TaskFingerprint.invalidityRule: A missing, ambiguous, prose-only, or non-canonical structural dimension makes the fingerprint invalid and pattern reuse DENIED.

TaskFamily.purpose: A closed set of structurally substitutable task variants sharing acceptance invariants.
TaskFamily.membershipRule: Every membership clause must be TRUE, no exclusion clause may be TRUE, and exactly one registered family may match.
TaskFamily.variantAxesRule: Each axis names one TaskFingerprint structural dimension allowed to vary while all invariantIds remain satisfied.
TaskFamily.familyLabelRule: A shared label, vocabulary, repository path, or visual similarity is not family membership evidence.

KnowledgeBundle.purpose: The immutable knowledge baseline available to both comparison arms.
admissionRules: Every content and provenance digest validates.
Scope and exact versions cover the TaskFingerprint.
The bundle contains no SolutionPattern, episode outcome, planted label, holdout answer, or holdout-derived edit.
The identical canonicalDigest is supplied to both retrieval arms.

EvidenceRecord.immutabilityRule: Evidence is referenced by canonical digest; edits create a new evidenceId and digest.
EvidenceRecord.outcomeRule: Outcome facts are typed machine fields bound by outcomeDigest; narrative summaries have no proof weight.

ProvenanceRecord.sealedRule: sealed must be true for proof evidence.
ProvenanceRecord.independenceRule: Two records are independent only when rootDigest differs, neither root is in the other's transitive parentDigests, and they are not duplicate observations of the same episode.

evidenceAndProvenance.retentionRule: Promotion never deletes or overwrites evidence, provenance, dependencies, known failures, counterexamples, or prior maturity decisions.

DependencyRecord.resolutionRule: Every referenced dependency must resolve to the required state, have admitted verification evidence, and be version-compatible before applicability can be TRUE.

CounterexampleRecord.rule: The blockingStructuralDimension must name a TaskFingerprint structural dimension; similarity facts never override it.

CounterevidenceAssessment.absenceRule: Missing assessment, INCOMPLETE coverage, no search evidence, or no negative control is ABSENT_COUNTEREVIDENCE. Empty knownFailureRefs or counterexampleRefs is valid only when the COMPLETE digest-bound search explicitly reports zero findings.

VersionConstraint.rule: allowedExactValues is a non-empty sorted set. Wildcards, implicit ranges, coercion, nearest-version matching, and prose compatibility claims are invalid.

versionCompatibility.compatibleIff: For every SolutionPattern version constraint, the TaskFingerprint versionVector contains the same componentId and versionScheme and its exact value is in allowedExactValues; every cited compatibility evidence record is admitted.
versionCompatibility.driftRule: A new component value is incompatible until separately admitted evidence adds that exact value to a new version-constraint digest. Prior evidence is retained.

SolutionPattern.statusRule: Every S0-S6 record remains a candidate and supplies no live authority.
SolutionPattern.preservationRule: dependencyRefs, evidenceRefs, provenanceRefs, knownFailureRefs, counterexampleRefs, and versionConstraintRefs are append-preserving across maturity transitions; superseding records retain the prior canonicalDigest.
SolutionPattern.preconditionRule: preconditions is a non-empty conjunction of predicateClause records. A false, unknown, missing, or prose-only precondition denies reuse.
SolutionPattern.applicabilityFirstRule: The complete applicability gate runs before procedure content is returned to the KNOWLEDGE_PLUS_EXPERIENCE arm.

maturityModel.promotionRule: Promotion is one level at a time, requires every prior level, and is computed only from admitted digest-bound evidence. Frequency never substitutes for a requirement.

levels.name: REPEATED
requirements: At least two provenance-independent observations with the same procedure and expected-outcome digests.

levels.name: STRUCTURED_CANDIDATE
requirements: All requiredFieldsAtS2AndAbove are present and valid.
At least three provenance-independent observations support the candidate.
Dependencies, preconditions, exact version bounds, failures, counterexamples, and provenance are preserved.

levels.name: APPLICABILITY_BOUNDED
requirements: At least one admitted contrast pair supports the declared boundary.
No known OPEN or INVALIDATES_PATTERN failure remains.

levels.name: HOLDOUT_IDENTIFIED
requirements: P18 is PASS on a sealed, non-leaking holdout suite.
All similar-looking inapplicable and version-drift controls are DENIED for the expected typed reason.

levels.name: SHADOW_BENEFICIAL
requirements: P17 is PASS in paired shadow replay.
P18 remains PASS on the same sealed evidence boundary.
No applicability or safety denial regresses against KNOWLEDGE_ONLY.

levels.name: STABLE_SHADOW_CANDIDATE
requirements: S5 is replicated on at least two disjoint sealed holdout batches bound by admitted provenance.
P17 and P18 are PASS independently on each batch.
No unresolved failure, provenance conflict, applicability ambiguity, or unsupported version is present.

demotionRules: An INVALIDATES_PATTERN failure denies all retrieval and resets the next admissible record to no higher than S2.
A new unbounded OPEN failure denies retrieval until a digest-bound precondition or invalidation decision resolves it.
Invalid provenance, holdout leakage, or an invalid diversity proof removes the affected evidence and recomputes maturity from admitted evidence only.
Version drift denies the drifted task without rewriting historical maturity evidence.

validIff: All referenced evidence and provenance are admitted and provenance-independent.
All finiteMinimums are met after canonical-digest deduplication.
Every variant belongs unambiguously to a declared TaskFamily.
The contrast pair changes the candidate procedure or declared applicability fact while holding the registered comparison facts constant.
No training episode or derivative appears in the sealed holdout set.

evaluationOrder: Validate canonical encodings, digests, schemas, evidence, and provenance.
Resolve exactly one TaskFamily from the TaskFingerprint.
Require the candidate TaskFamily set to contain that exact familyId.
Evaluate every applicability clause and precondition using three-valued predicate evaluation.
Deny any TaskFingerprint matching an unresolved known failure or counterexample boundary.
Require a COMPLETE counterevidence assessment and sufficient maturity.
Only then return procedure content to a simulation or shadow arm.
applicabilityGate.allowIff: Every ordered gate is satisfied and the candidate is S3 or higher; the result is APPLICABLE_SHADOW_ONLY.
applicabilityGate.ambiguityRule: Any contradictory match, missing fact, UNKNOWN predicate, or inability to distinguish applicable from inapplicable is AMBIGUOUS_APPLICABILITY and DENIED.
applicabilityGate.similarityRule: Similarity can neither skip nor alter a gate. A similar-looking task with a family mismatch, false or unknown precondition, dependency mismatch, matched boundary, or incompatible version is DENIED.
applicabilityGate.outOfVocabularyRule: An operator, status, effect class, evidence kind, version scheme, or replay mode outside closedVocabulary is PROSE_ONLY_INPUT and DENIED.

holdoutProtocol.sourceBinding: The admitted #288 root digest must transitively bind the corpus manifest, family registry, KnowledgeBundle, training/holdout split, planted labels, dependency and version fixtures, replay inputs, expected checks, and event ledger.
holdoutProtocol.pairingRule: For each holdoutVariantId, both arms use the identical pairedRunKey and expected-check set. KNOWLEDGE_PLUS_EXPERIENCE adds only candidates that passed the applicability gate; KNOWLEDGE_ONLY receives no SolutionPattern content.
holdoutProtocol.separationRule: The holdout split and planted labels are sealed before candidate mining. Any direct or transitive overlap, post-hoc relabeling, or holdout-derived candidate edit is HOLDOUT_LEAKAGE.

costLedger.rule: Each emitted retrieval item, candidate step, tool call, and check run contributes exactly one cost unit. Repeated events count again; untyped or missing events invalidate the paired run.

holdoutProtocol.zeroDenominatorRule: A required metric with a zero denominator is INCONCLUSIVE; it is never treated as zero, one, or vacuous PASS.

P17.claim: Applicable historical experience improves holdout quality per cost over Knowledge-only retrieval without an applicability or safety regression.

perVariantMetrics.cost_arm_i: sum(unitCost for every charged cost event in arm i)

passIff: The #288 digest and every transitive input are admitted.
The diversity proof, KnowledgeBundle, pairing, provenance, and holdout separation are valid.
For every holdout variant, qualityDelta_i is at least 0 and costReduction_i is at least 0.
Aggregate qualityDelta is at least 0 and aggregate costReduction is at least 0.
At least one of aggregate qualityDelta or aggregate costReduction is strictly greater than 0.
Aggregate efficiencyDelta is strictly greater than 0.
Every expected applicability, dependency, counterexample, and version denial matches its typed reason in both arms.
No required check, safety check, or expected denial regresses in KNOWLEDGE_PLUS_EXPERIENCE.

P18.claim: The protocol identifies planted stable patterns and rejects frequency-only, narrow-context, and correlation traps.
P18.classificationRule: A planted stable candidate is identified only at S4 or higher. Every trap must remain below S4 with a typed denial tied to its missing requirement; raw occurrence count has no independent weight.
passIff: The #288 digest and every transitive input are admitted and all required fixture populations are non-zero.
The holdout is sealed, provenance-independent, non-leaking, and has a valid diversity proof.
Every similar-looking inapplicable task, ambiguous applicability fixture, incompatible-version fixture, and unknown-version fixture is DENIED for the expected typed reason.
Every promoted candidate has a COMPLETE counterevidence assessment and preserves dependencies, failures, counterexamples, and provenance.

trapDenials.FREQUENCY_ONLY_TRAP: DENIED when repetitions are duplicate, provenance-dependent, not diverse, lack contrast evidence, or fail holdout support.
trapDenials.NARROW_CONTEXT_TRAP: DENIED with INVALID_DIVERSITY_PROOF when context or variant-axis minimums are not met.
trapDenials.CORRELATION_TRAP: DENIED when no admitted contrast pair isolates the claimed pattern boundary.

shadowOnlySemantics.inputRule: Replay reads only immutable, admitted, digest-bound evidence and pinned local fixtures.
shadowOnlySemantics.ablationRule: KNOWLEDGE_ONLY suppresses SolutionPattern retrieval without deleting or rewriting history; KNOWLEDGE_PLUS_EXPERIENCE exposes only applicability-approved candidates.
shadowOnlySemantics.outputRule: Outputs are comparison records and candidate maturity decisions only.
shadowOnlySemantics.effectRule: No replay may invoke an external effect, modify product state, grant authority, update a live memory, promote a candidate into live use, collect live telemetry, or contact a model or service.
shadowOnlySemantics.evidenceBoundaryRule: A replay result applies only to the exact evidence, family, dependency, and version digests it names.
shadowOnlySemantics.forbiddenModeRule: Any mode other than SIMULATION or SHADOW is DENIED with LIVE_REPLAY_FORBIDDEN.

predecessor288.digestField: sha256 root digest over the canonical #288 evidence manifest

minimumProofSet: canonical TaskFingerprint for every episode and holdout variant
identical admitted KnowledgeBundle in both arms
typed required-check outcomes and charged cost events
requiredEvidence.noEvidenceNoSuccessRule: No PASS, promotion, stable label, applicability approval, or reuse claim is valid when any required evidence is missing, malformed, unsealed, ambiguous, incompatible, prose-only, or not transitively bound by the admitted root digest.

alternatives.reason: It can expose an inapplicable procedure before family, precondition, dependency, counterexample, and version checks.
Duplicates and correlated or narrow-context repetitions do not prove diversity, applicability, or holdout benefit.

alternatives.alternative: Infer missing typed facts from prose or reviewer rationale
alternatives.reason: It is non-deterministic and violates fail-closed evidence admission.

alternatives.alternative: Treat semver proximity or unlisted versions as compatible
alternatives.reason: Compatibility is evidence-bound to exact admitted values; drift remains denied until separately proved.

alternatives.alternative: Online ablation, live replay, automatic application, or telemetry-backed promotion
alternatives.reason: This slice is simulation and shadow-only and grants no effect or release authority.

alternatives.alternative: Claim P17 or P18 from the vocabulary or unbound examples
alternatives.reason: Only admitted #288-bound holdout evidence can support those claims.

explicitNonclaims: This receipt does not claim that P17 passes.
This receipt does not claim that P18 passes.
This receipt does not claim any historical-experience quality, cost, efficiency, causal, or generalization improvement.
This receipt does not claim that any SolutionPattern is S4, S5, S6, stable, production-ready, or live-applicable.
This receipt does not synthesize, guess, or repair the missing #288 digest or any transitive evidence.
This receipt does not authorize product code, model or service calls, live effects, telemetry, publication, merge, or release.
Shadow evidence does not establish production safety, production compatibility, or authority outside its exact digest boundary.
